purpose: Fresh-base restricted six-class categorical outcome adaptation; development only
checkpoint_selection: Use only final52microstep candidate; one fixed seed, no alternatives, no resumption of prior message adapter
loss: Mean cross entropy over exactly six ordered A-F token logits at the first assistant position, using observed integer final category as label. No full-vocabulary or EOS loss.
prediction: Float32 softmax restricted to the same six token logits, with raw logits and full-vocabulary probability mass on those tokens logged for both base and candidate
interpretation: Conditional probabilities over six recorded answer categories, not measured latent beliefs or established calibration. Validity by construction is a pipeline check, not evidence of behavioral improvement. No message capability retention claim.
gate: Both models cover all24 internal cases with finite six-class vectors. Seal both predictions, evaluator and baseline before reading internal outcomes. Equal-group candidate-minus-base RPS <=0.02 is an engineering entry guard, requiring review of all group effects, before considering a separately frozen four-group validation run. No prompt/checkpoint tuning on internal outcomes.
failures: Stop on nonfinite loss/logits/probabilities, resource limit or integrity mismatch; retain all artifacts. No retries or repair. Root supervises train and two sequential prediction processes under fixed stage deadlines.
